title: Catalog
description: Matches Kotlin Catalog(schemaVersion, catalogRevision, entries[]) / CatalogEntry(id, version, language, title, publication, unitCount, lessonCount, phraseCount, audioCount, manifestKey, manifestSha256, manifestBytes, downloadBytes, retired=false). Total serialized size must stay <= 2 MiB. Retired packs remain listed with retired=true so offline devices can react without an unpromised immediate revocation.

publication.description: Matches Kotlin PublicationStatus. Copied verbatim from the manifest's own top-level 'publication' string; no nested revision (see manifest.schema.json).

lessonCount.description: Exact number of lesson entries in the manifest's lessons[] array. Distinct from unitCount (a coarser topical grouping); always the literal len(manifest.lessons).

downloadBytes.description: Honest total download size shown to the user before requesting the pack: manifestBytes + sum(asset.bytes). Never manifestBytes alone. Capped at 50 MiB.
